name: meadow
steps: Begin in Mint Meadow with its world ambience and portal hum.
hud: Leave a world. Hear what stays behind.
Sound ownership, cleanup and lingering echoes
Each world owns its sounds. Leaving destroys that owner, so its ambience stops. Choose whether the portal echo stops too, or finishes at the place you left. Your ears travel with DEV505.
Listen to this world. The next one sounds different.
Only this world's ambience and hum remain.
